rationale: Independently verified the candidate, authored-v7, both complete recipe/concept reviews, all source bindings, 131 runtime hashes and all 252 source snapshots. Proposal preserves the reviewed 352 recipes and existing world/goals/unlocks/history, with only factual-approved source normalization. Matched all 33 direct service goal replays: 148 productive discoveries reach all 252 concepts; completed recipes are retried without new discoveries, and restoration preserves progress and owned IDs. Recomputed the ten deterministic historical paths and their 1,156 nonempty prefixes; recorded checks preserve earned concepts and discoveries. Privacy evidence is scoped to initial hidden goal target IDs and the current state serializer omitting the recipe book. No HTTP coverage, arbitrary-order history coverage or full restored-state equality is inferred.
